title: Two K-Pop Stars Team Up for Their First Duo Album
summary:
For more than ten years, Jeonghan and Joshua have shared the stage with their 11 bandmates in Seventeen, one of K-pop's best-selling groups. Now the two singers have their own project. "Dreamscape" is their first album as a duo called JxJ.

It is also Jeonghan's first new music since he finished South Korea's required military service this summer. While he was away, Seventeen kept performing, and he sometimes watched his bandmates from the audience with fans, who are known as Carats. "I missed those moments on stage," he told Variety.

Joshua spent that time producing songs and sending them to the group's company. Jeonghan said he was amazed by how clear an idea Joshua had about the album's musical direction. Joshua helped write his solo song, "Not Personal," and Jeonghan helped write the words to his solo, "Coloring."

At first, the two did not agree on their sound. Joshua said Jeonghan wanted a stronger style, while he wanted something subtle and mature. "Eventually, we met at the middle," Joshua said. The result is the title song "12 O'Clock," a dance-rock track inspired by disco and funk from the 1970s and 1980s. Its title refers to both noon and midnight, one time for chasing goals and one for dreaming.

The seven-song album mixes house, R&B, soul and band sounds. "We just really wanted the whole album to feel like a journey between traveling through dreams and reality," Joshua said.

Joshua grew up in Los Angeles. He said singing as a duo lets him show more of his voice, since his parts in the 13-member group can be very short. A tour is planned after the album's promotions.
why_it_matters: The album shows how members of a big group can explore new styles and grow as artists in smaller projects. It also shows how two people with different ideas can compromise to make something new.

keywords.explanation: A duo is a pair of people who perform together.
Military service is time spent serving in a country's armed forces; in South Korea most men are required to do it.
Producing music means shaping how a song is made, from its sound to its recording.
Subtle means gentle and not obvious or loud.
Funk is a style of music with a strong, bouncy rhythm and bass that makes people want to dance.

background_read: K-pop is popular music from South Korea known for big groups, catchy songs and detailed dance routines.
Some K-pop groups form smaller units, so a few members can try a different style while still belonging to the main group.
South Korea requires most men to serve in the military, so K-pop stars often take a break from performing to do their service.
Seventeen is a 13-member group, and its fans are called Carats.
